# Architecture

The planned data flow is Scenario Registry → capability-aware Adapter + Opportunity Profile → Isolated Controlled Runner → Normalized Trace → deterministic Oracle/Policy Graders → 20-Metric Scorer → AOS-Coding P0 issuance → deterministic one-lever Diagnosis → Markdown/JSON Reporter.

Trust boundaries are defined in ADR-0004 through ADR-0010. Missing observability never becomes an operator penalty; unsafe actions, invalid identity/integrity, and insufficient evidence withhold the score. Codex is implemented before the differentiated FAM-4/5/6 wedge; Claude Code and FAM-1/2/3 follow G0.
